description:
Home safety and home maintenance made simple. I'm Earl Dawson — 40 years building and fixing homes. I show you the hidden dangers in your house and the cheap fixes most homeowners never learn, so you protect your home and family without getting robbed on the repair bill.

A house always tells you first. Every danger — water that rots it slow, heat and fire that take it fast — warns you before the disaster. A $5 look beats a $15,000 repair.

Frozen pipes, dryer-vent fires, carbon monoxide, winter prep, water damage, electrical warning signs — plain English, practical fixes. For homeowners, retirees, and anyone living alone.

🔔 New home walk-through every few days.

Earl is an AI storytelling persona; tips are researched and fact-checked (NFPA, FEMA, Red Cross, CPSC). Education only — for serious issues, call a licensed pro.

videos.title: 35 Home-Defense Tricks Retired Cops Teach Seniors Living Alone That Cost Pennies
When the Power Goes Out This Winter, Do These 8 Things First
7 Things That Quietly Destroy Your House Every Winter
